notes.title: Fix - NIT-FR-06 Boss Rush Softlock and Visual Error
notes.notes:
[h2]Softlock Error[/h2][p]This update is being made to address an error where, if the player deals too much damage in one attack while fighting NIT-FR-06 (Robo frog), the game would hang after the death cutscene played from that attack. It also addresses an error where, if the attack does NOT kill, the frog would behave in a glitchy manner.  The phases should now progress as normal and not encounter problems like before.  [/p][h2]Postgame Formatting[/h2][p]This is a minor change, but I realize that as a general user flow issue, most people would receive the "You have unlocked new items in the Extras menu" notification, and then go straight there from the game finishing. This means they would skip over the boss rush prompt, and may not realize you can re-access it by restarting the game, or forget to try do so. 

I added the option to enter the boss rush to the Extras menu with the other new options instead, so that should help players be more aware of it. It also helps with the general user flow between menus by giving a way to get from the main menu to boss rush easily.

Due to this, I may later remove the opening the game prompt to access either game mode entirely, or at least confine it to only occur on the first boot.

[/p][h2]Bug Reports[/h2][p]Please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board, and I'll fix them in a timely manner: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/[/url] Thank you for your patience and support![/p]

notes.title: Boss Rush Update - Release (!!) + Cirno Day Discount
notes.notes:
[p][u][b]Happy Cirno Day everyone!![/b][/u][/p][p]By the time this update releases it may have already passed for some users sadly, but I hope you'll be able to enjoy it nonetheless.[/p][h1]Boss Rush[/h1][p]This content update includes several things to talk about, and acts as a mini post-game epilogue story to play once the true ending has been completed. If you have completed the final boss of the main game, all you need to do to access this content is start the game on a finished save file:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193827/bcdb786c40ee23f06584789fcefea2d5631fbe78.png"][/img][/p][p]New players will still go straight to the intro of the main game upon launch, so no major flow issues are introduced to the initial base game experience. Also, you can [u][b]now hold the Z Button to skip the logo crawl[/b][/u], regardless of having finished the game or not, so anyone who prefers the former state has the ability to skip past them at least.[/p][p][/p][h2]Content[/h2][p]While I don't want to spoil too much before you hop in and try it yourself, I will briefly outline what this update is: [/p][p]There is a [b]new mode[/b], the aforementioned boss rush, which will test the player to defeat all the threats they have faced so far with new [b]upgrades[/b] each time they play, but also one new one at the end... [/p][p]This mode will be playable both independently (without dialogue, after finishing it once.) and as a [b]small mini-story[/b] that takes place right after the conclusion of the main game, and will itself have its own ending to experience.[/p][previewyoutube="2MK3aiZSlsY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It also contains [u][b]3 more achievements[/b][/u], one of which is for unlocking all achievements at last, so hopefully you will all enjoy getting those. I don't want to spoil too much about the direct contents, but I hope you will all enjoy it![/p][p][/p][h2]Soundtrack[/h2][p]So, after the initial unfortunate delays, the soundtrack is finally being released in parallel with this update! [/p][p]The soundtrack will be released on a discount running concurrently with the main game's discount, and will include all of the songs in the base game. In addition, the songs from the [b]Boss Rush content update[/b] will be updated into the soundtrack soon for free to anyone who owns it; past, present, or future. This will occur within a couple days of release in an extra update.[/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Reports[/h2][p]As always, for anyone who does encounter bugs, crashes, or unpleasant game behaviours, please submit any bugs you come across to this discussion board, and I'll fix them in a timely manner:[/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/[/url]
Thank you for your patience and support! [/p][p]I hope you'll enjoy it! [/p][p]Sincerely, SilvaMemoria.[/p]

notes.title: Elusive Teleportation Bug - Alleviated
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]The content update I intended to make is nearly complete, and I hope it may be released on a certain special day, if possible... 
In the meantime however, I located an occasional error that I had never been able to reproduce before, and still haven't been able to, but I DO believe I know what caused it, and I made the solution significantly smoother.[/p][h2][b]Mysterious Teleportation[/b][/h2][p align="start"]I set up a safeguard earlier in my development for a rare circumstance where characters might get stuck in cutscenes. Occasionally, this seemed to trigger without TRULY being stuck (possibly on poorer computers or ones running streaming software or similar) and caused the safeguard to kick in, locking the character to their destination immediately. [/p][p align="start"]I couldn't exactly find a way to make the engine work more correctly at this stage of post-development without changing a vast amount of other elements, so I hope that the new solution will be less intrusive. Now, the character will simply begin to move regardless of the system getting stuck, so rather than warping, characters will just walk towards their location with a minor delay at the same speed they usually would've and without collision. [/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Bug Reports[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Unfortunately as stated, I couldn't actually find a way to reproduce this bug. I want to thank several users and a few Twitch streamers who helped me find this explaining their situations or having clips where this occurred themselves, and I apologize to those who have been affected by this.[/p][p align="start"]If you DO still have this or new, similar issues, and find there is some error related to characters walking strangely or still teleporting at the start of some cutscenes, please send me a message or email in one of the following places:[/p][p align="start"]X/Twitter: 
[url="https://x.com/SilvaMemoriaX"]https://x.com/SilvaMemoriaX[/url] [/p][p align="start"]Steam Bug Reporter Thread: 
[url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/"]https://steamcommunity.com/app/3218680/discussions/0/598527550147298302/[/url][/p][p align="start"]Email: 
[url="https://silvamemoriax@gmail.com"]silvamemoriax@gmail.com[/url][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]I'll be sure to do my best to make the game as good as it can be![/p]

notes.title: Localization Frameworks, News, and Minor Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! [/p][h2]Framework for Localization[/h2][p]Now, you won't be able to see this change very much, but under the hood, every change necessary for localizing the game has been made to all the in-game systems. It was the first time I ever worked with such a thing, so I had some learning to do, but I'm glad the systems provided were robust and convenient to work with! I'll definitely try to do this work before or early in the release in future if possible.[/p][p]Currently, we have two translations that are planned for the immediate future. On a [b]first-contact basis[/b] of the [b]translators who reached out to us[/b], those will be [u]Japanese[/u] and [u]Chinese[/u]. notes.title: Loading Screens, Lag, And Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Loading Screens and Battle Lag[/h2]
So, it was brought more to my attention that occasionally, some moves would "lag" the very first time they're used. I realized in testing that there was a problem with the method in which resources were loaded and cached, and I have fixed it. 

To add further on this, for the [u]first major loading screen[/u] (that is, upon starting/loading a new game, [u]not[/u] every single one between areas), there will now be a proper loading screen graphic to convey the loading progress, and that it might take slightly longer than others.

This should remove all lag during fights in the main story, and in my experience this loading screen only seems to take 1-2 seconds at most.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
This patch fixes a few small visual glitches in some battles. 
In addition, it was reported to me that the Red Frog battle may, in some very fringe cases, lead to freezing (Ironically).

Neither I nor the initial reporter could reproduce this error, but I made sure to rework the likely source just in case, so it hopefully will not occur anymore.

notes.title: New Features, Summer Sale, and Soundtrack News/Future Plans
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is the first non-bugfix update for Touhou: Fearless Frogslayer. I hope you enjoy the new additions![/p][h1]New Feature - Battle and Chapter Menu[/h1][p]So, quite a few people liked the battles and some specific elements of the game a lot, but obviously were hindered by the simplistic save system which would require inconveniently playing through the entire game again to replay a cool battle or get a certain achievement.[/p][p]In this update, the [u]Options[/u] button in the title screen has become [u]Extras[/u], which now contains options inside it, and now, if you have finished the game, two new menus will unlock![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193827/12db27ce8cba28bbfe4b758154a20325831a23c6.png"][/img][i](This menu may also be used for future features, if any are added.)[/i][/p][h3][u]Battle Menu[/u][/h3][p]The battle menu allows you to replay any battle in the game from the convenience of the menu, and if you hold down [u][b]Shift[/b][/u] (Or the [b][u]controller bumpers[/u][/b]), you can skip any dialogue in the battles, as you've already read them by having finished the game. This should give players the ability to experience any battle they've wanted to retry without having to replay the entire game to do so, or show something cool off to their friends, without the inconvenience of all the replayed content.[/p][h3][u]Chapter Menu[/u][/h3][p]Alongside the new battle features, you can now access any point in the game from the main menu as well, as long as you have completed the game. This will make anyone wanting to hunt for achievements they missed have a much easier and less tedious time tracking through the game again, even if it is rather short overall.[/p][p][/p][p]Both of these menus also allow you to see the frog book drawings and save screen drawings conveniently, now with something added for the final boss as well...[/p][p][/p][h1]Summer Sale[/h1][p]A more minor element obviously, the game is now on its first sale!!
I hope that many people will want to check out Touhou: Fearless Frogslayer, and enjoy the game that we have worked on.[/p][p]The sale will be running from [i][b]10AM Pacific Time [/b][/i]today (26/06) until the [i][b]10th of July[/b][/i], two weeks later.[/p][p][/p][h1]Future News[/h1][p]So, as this is my first significant non-bugfix update, I would like to share some future plans with you all!![/p][h3][u]Soundtrack[/u][/h3][p]Firstly, I want to address the soundtrack, which I mentioned on my X/Twitter account (link embedded at the bottom of the page) would be released at some point after the game was first released. [/p][p]Unfortunately, the composer's device had a fatal error in the process of uploading the soundtrack, so there was a rather big delay. Luckily, due to smart storage procedures, nothing has been lost in terms of sound files, but we can't upload it for this update as previously intended.[/p][p]If you'd like to wishlist the soundtrack, you can find it here: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837540/Touhou_Fearless_Frogslayer_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink]The soundtrack will likely be ready at some point in July or August, so thank you for your patience.[/p][h3][u]Translations[/u][/h3][p]While I technically cannot prove just yet that I'll actually be able to afford to translate the game, I have received many requests for it in some languages (e.g. Chinese, Portuguese), so I still wish to work towards that in the hope that it'll be possible to pull off. In the next few months I'll be creating a system to collaborate with people who have offered translations in past, and to test whether or not it is possible for the game's resolution to handle different scripts (Cyrilic, Kanji, etc.).  [u](Note: I have not guaranteed yet that the game CAN handle these scripts, so I apologize if it ends up being impossible for certain languages.)[/u][/p][p][/p][p]Anyways, that's all for today. Thank you to everyone who bought and played the game, as well as the many people who wishlisted and supported it!! I hope to make the game the best it can be, and then move onto even better projects in future!
Goodbye![/p]

notes.title: Native Controller Support

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Hello everyone, as of this update, I fixed a problem that was disabling controller support from functioning correctly. The game should now have partial support for most standard controller types. Currently, the only [u]FULL[/u] support is for controllers that utilize the Xbox standard layout (Wherein the A-button is at the bottom). 

Other controllers such as Sony and Nintendo models [i]should[/i] still work, but you'll have to simply use their respective [b]bottom[/b] and [b]right[/b] buttons rather than the A/B prompts provided by the in-game controller annotations.


If you have any issues with playing using a controller, please notify me here:
